drifted.spec_text: On initialization, the IEvictionPolicy receptacle MUST be connected (returns an error if unbound).
drifted.actual: initialize() calls get_pool_id() first, which does eviction_policy.get().unwrap(); an unbound eviction_policy panics before the graceful map_err(NotInitialized) path is reached. Same unwrap in create_memory_tier_entry, recover_extent, oldest_keys.

drifted.spec_text: US1/AS3 + Edge Cases: create_memory_tier_entry with a null pointer returns an error; no entry is recorded.
drifted.actual: create_memory_tier_entry only validates size == 0 (InvalidSize); there is no null-pointer check, so a null pointer is accepted and an entry is recorded.
